name: Video Production
tagline: Broadcast-quality animated video, made under your brand.
description: Explainers, product demos, launch promos, and social spots, produced end to end by our in-house motion team and delivered 100% white-label. You hand off the brief; we handle script, storyboard, design, animation, voiceover, and sound, then return a finished cut your client believes you made.

deliverables.description: Clear, on-brand explainers that turn a complex offer into something a prospect understands in under two minutes.

deliverables.title: Product demo animations
deliverables.description: Motion walkthroughs that show a product or feature working, without the cost of a live shoot.

deliverables.title: Scripts and storyboards
deliverables.description: We write the script and board every scene before a frame is animated, so the direction is approved up front.

deliverables.title: Custom motion graphics
deliverables.description: Bespoke animation and graphics built to the client's brand, not dropped from a template library.

deliverables.title: Voiceover and sound design

deliverables.title: On-brand visual style
deliverables.description: Every frame is styled to the client's colors, fonts, and tone, and ships without a trace of growX.

deliverables.title: Multi-platform cutdowns

deliverables.title: Source files included

faq.question: Is the video really unbranded?
faq.answer: Yes. There are no watermarks, credits, or metadata pointing back to growX. You deliver it as your studio's work.

faq.question: What do you need from us to start?
faq.answer: A short brief and the client's brand assets. We handle scripting and storyboarding from there and get your sign-off before animating.

faq.question: How many revision rounds are included?
faq.answer: Every project ships with defined revision rounds at the script, storyboard, and final-cut stages, so feedback is structured rather than open-ended. The exact number is listed on the order in the portal.

faq.question: What formats do we get back?
faq.answer: The final video in the aspect ratios your client needs, plus source files. You can hand off a web version, a square feed cut, and a vertical Reels or Shorts cut from a single production.

faq.question: How is it priced?
faq.answer: Fixed price per production with a clear scope and delivery SLA, ordered in one click from the partner portal.

hero.ctaNote: 30 minutes with our founding team. No pitch deck, no pressure.

pains.sub: Video is the most requested deliverable in marketing — and the hardest one to staff, scope, and ship on time.

pricing.sub: One flat rate per video, quoted before you commit. You invoice your client at your price — we never touch the relationship.

guarantees.title: Scope-locked quote
guarantees.description: The quoted price is the final price. Length, style, and deliverables are agreed before production starts.

guarantees.title: Truly unbranded delivery
guarantees.description: No watermarks, no credits, no fingerprints anywhere — and the source files we hand over prove it.

guarantees.title: Staged approvals
guarantees.description: You sign off at script, storyboard, and final cut — nothing moves forward, or reaches your client, without you.

guarantees.title: Full rights + source files

differentiators.sub: Full production under one roof, styled to each client's brand, and delivered ready for every platform.

faqExtra.question: What counts as one video?
faqExtra.answer: One master video up to roughly 90 seconds, including its platform cutdowns, thumbnails, and caption files. Longer formats or genuinely separate concepts are quoted as multiples — your quote lists everything before you commit.

faqExtra.question: Do you do live-action video?
faqExtra.answer: This service is animation and motion graphics end to end. For live-action footage your client already has, our Video Editing service cuts, grades, and packages it — same white-label terms, and the two pair well.

faqExtra.question: Can you match an existing animation style?
faqExtra.answer: Yes. We build style frames from your client's existing brand or reference videos and get your sign-off before any animation starts — so the finished video looks like episode two, not a different studio.

faqExtra.question: Who owns the video and its rights?
faqExtra.answer: Your client, fully: the final cuts, the source files, and full commercial rights. Voiceover and music licensing are cleared for commercial use before delivery.
